reviewMethod.method: Each candidate was compared by upstream and Dart test bodies, not title alone. actualAssertions list the Dart expect/expectLater calls verbatim (whitespace-normalized, truncated at 360 chars). Upstream assertions are included for review.
reviewMethod.adaptations: TypeScript SyntaxError maps to Dart FormatException; AbortSignal/AbortController map to CancellationSignal/CancellationController; Headers maps to Map<String,String>; fetchClient maps to client; ReadableStream lock/cancel semantics map to Dart stream cancellation. Missing normalize/merge/wire cases are marked missing rather than silently claimed.
reviewMethod.sseCleanup: The seven sse-parser-cleanup cases are mapped to test/interop/client_boundaries_upstream_test.dart, which drives the real GenerationClient with http.StreamedResponse and is reported 7/7 passing.
